acceptance_criteria: resolution, out-of-vocabulary, and duplicate/unknown-reference cases; CHK-15, NEG-21, NEG-22, NEG-32.
statement: For an orphan intent, the journal **shall** allow appending exactly one explicit resolution outcome with a bounded kind (including `Unknown`) that references the original request id; a repeated or unknown-resolution request **shall** be rejected without mutation, an `OutcomeKind` outside the closed vocabulary **shall** be rejected (`RejectedConfiguration`) without appending, and an explicit `Unknown` resolution **shall** never be relabelled delivered.
title: T026 requirement 014
